paragraphs: I'm an ambitious and passionate developer with a strong interest in web development, game design, physics, and music. My journey started with curiosity about how things work — it grew into a commitment to building meaningful digital experiences.

A graduate of SMKN 2 Magelang (PPLG major), now working full-time at Reka Solusi Teknologi. I experiment daily with Next.js, Laravel, Flutter, Three.js, and anything that challenges me. When I'm not coding, I'm exploring game engines, thinking about physics, or listening to music.
